dimensions.name: Universality
dimensions.definition: every invariant and state transition holds for code, firmware, media-render, game-engine, mobile, prose-creative and strategy work without assuming a substrate (git master, one checkout, test suites, CI); domain specifics live only in adapters

dimensions.name: Measurability
dimensions.definition: every invariant has a concrete shadow measurement, a PASS/FAIL/WARN/UNKNOWN rule, and never rounds UNKNOWN to PASS; the tool and the spec name the same invariants

dimensions.name: Anti-Fixpoint Honesty
dimensions.definition: the kernel detects governance motion masquerading as progress, separates adoption from delivery, bounds admission by eligible work, and forbids manufactured backlog

dimensions.name: Adoption Cost
dimensions.definition: a project with any native ledger (or none) can dogfood in shadow in under an hour without replacing machinery, and the manifest fields are sufficient and unambiguous

dimensions.name: Self-Improvement Loop
dimensions.definition: feedback records, harvest, proposals, review, landing, demotion and promotion form an executable, falsifiable loop with evidence thresholds, versioning and no single-writer conflicts

dimensions.name: Authority Safety
dimensions.definition: shadow mode grants zero authority, owner-reserved actions are preserved, promotion and enforcement require recorded owner acts, and nothing creates an escalation path

seat_roster.lens: coherence and completeness - is every term defined once, every invariant measurable as written, every adapter field used; could a project dogfood from this document alone without asking a question.

universality adversary - pick the domain where each invariant breaks (a novel, an Unreal project with binary assets, a mobile app gated on store review, a business plan) and show the break with a quote.
adoption cost - walk a project with a markdown ledger, one with a database ledger and one with no ledger through §5 and §7; count the questions they would have to ask.
measurement adversary - where can a shadow check PASS while the invariant is violated, or FAIL while it holds (glob misclassification, stale receipts, ledgers that lie, worktree counts).
self-improvement loop - can §8 actually change the kernel: proposal evidence thresholds, review cost, versioning, demotion, promotion; where does the loop stall or become governance motion itself.
Codex design explorer: kernel vs adapter vs substrate boundaries, the unit state machine's completeness, how Approach A or any other substrate would be qualified against K1-K11.
Codex verifier: authority safety - does anything in shadow mode, harvest or promotion let a project or tool act without an owner record; are single-writer paths and R7-R9 respected.
Codex implementer: implement kernel.py's checks and a new adapter from the spec alone; are manifest semantics, ledger kinds and result rules precise enough to code without guessing.

blinding: panel seats run independently in parallel; no score history; no other seat's output; design findings not shown to the panel; classifier sees panel blockers with seat labels stripped
composite: equal-weight mean of dimensions per seat; panel composite = equal mean over scored seats
